description: Rolled when a Vargr Extents career Event roll results in 'Life Event'. Roll 2D. Results 6 and 8 trigger the Pack Events sub-table.

2.title: Sickness or Injury
2.text: You are injured or sick. Roll on the Injury table.

3.title: Birth or Death
3.text: Someone close to you dies, such as a friend or pack member. Alternatively, someone close to you gives birth (or is born!). You are involved in some fashion.

4.title: Ending of Relationship
4.text: A romantic relationship involving you ends. Roll 1D: on 1-2 your mate is killed; on 3-4 your mate leaves you; on 5-6 you leave your mate.

5.title: New Relationship
5.text: You become romantically involved with an existing Ally, Contact, another Traveller or pack member.

6.title: Pack Event
6.text: Roll on the Pack Events table.

8.title: Pack Event
8.text: Roll on the Pack Events table.

9.title: Travel
9.text: You move to another world. Gain DM+2 to your next Qualification roll.

10.title: Good Fortune
10.text: Something good happens to you — you come into money unexpectedly, have a lifelong dream come true or have another stroke of good fortune. Gain a Benefit roll in your current career or gain SOC +1.

11.title: Crime
11.text: You commit a crime or are accused of a crime. Lose SOC -1.

12.title: Unusual Event
12.text: Something weird. Roll 1D: 1=Psionics; 2=Aliens (Language 1 or Science 1 + Contact); 3=Alien Artefact; 4=Amnesia; 5=Contact with Government (SOC+1); 6=Ancient Technology (left by the Ancients when they first brought the Vargr to Lair).

pack_events.name: Pack Events
pack_events.note: Travellers not currently in a pack roll SOC 7+ to join a new pack; on a failure, gain a Rival (result 6) or an Ally (result 8) instead.

results.1: Failure: Your failure causes a serious problem for your pack — the loss of a well-paid job or the death of a pack member. Lose SOC -1. If you are the pack leader, your pack will look to new leadership until you can redeem yourself.
results.2: Leave Pack: A change of situation, disagreement or lack of leadership forces you to leave your pack and your job. Roll SOC 6+ to find another job in your current field or you are ejected from your career.
results.3: Join Pack: You join a new pack. This can be a change of job or employer within your career, or you become involved with another group.
results.4: Power Struggle: The pack leader does not live up to the reputation their Charisma suggested and you look to others to replace them. Roll 1D: on a 1-3 the current leader keeps their position and you gain a Rival; on a 4-6 a new leader takes charge and you gain an Ally.
results.5: Success: You are successful at a particularly difficult task and exceed all expectations. Gain SOC +1.
results.6: Leadership Challenge: The pack leader fails in their role and the pack looks for a new leader. Roll Leadership or SOC 10+ to become the new leader. If you fail, another member is chosen and you gain a Rival.
